intro.title: Colors: hex, rgb, hsl
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple webpage that displays a set of colored boxes, each labeled with a different color format. You will learn the core concepts of specifying colors in CSS using three common methods: hexadecimal (hex), RGB (Red, Green, Blue), and HSL (Hue, Saturation, Lightness). The main technologies involved are CSS properties like `color` and `background-color`, along with their respective value formats. By the end, you'll be able to apply and compare these color formats to style text and backgrounds effectively.
intro.usecase: Color systems are foundational to every visual interface developers build. When creating design systems for products like dashboards or e-commerce platforms, you'll use hex codes for precise brand colors, RGB for dynamic theming (like dark/light mode), and HSL for intuitive color adjustments in UI components. For example, a weather app might use HSL to smoothly transition sky colors throughout the day, while an admin panel uses hex values to maintain consistent button and text colors across all modules. Mastering these color formats lets you implement professional designs exactly as specified by designers and create visually cohesive user experiences.
